dimensions.PUBLIC_PAGE_READY: The response may be exposed without private data or unsupported claims.
dimensions.INDEX_READY: The public response also has confirmed jurisdiction, one stable canonical URL, useful unique content, rights-cleared fields, deterministic source state, metadata, robots behavior, and sitemap eligibility.
dimensions.FEASIBILITY_READY: The page may show only the bounded rule conclusions supported for that parcel; this is independent of INDEX_READY.
dimensions.PROGRAM_ELIGIBILITY_READY: A named program may use eligibility language only after every required eligibility predicate and source is verified; mapped context alone is insufficient.
